reason: The README clearly describes a web-composer utility that rewrites user drafts through the connected LLM using selectable styles, so general-utilities is the best primary category.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框中提供提示词润色按钮，使用已连接的大模型按所选风格改写草稿并替换输入内容供用户审核。
summaries.en: Adds a web-composer button to rewrite draft prompts with the connected language model in a selected style before sending.

capabilities: Adds a sparkle button and style menu to the web composer
Sends the draft prompt to the connected language model for rewriting
Replaces the composer draft with the rewritten text for user review
Supports optional provider, model, style, token-limit, and system-instruction configuration
